nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The registry is a hall of folding tables. Laptops on car batteries. A Guard captain walks the rows like a teacher.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: Name, address, household. Skills. Be honest about skills; it changes your ration tier.

choices.text: Braith Pearce. A&P mechanic. Ex-Air Force.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: Because pumps, trucks and generators keep this valley alive. And people who fix them eat first.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: F-15 crew chief? Mountain Home? ...Pearce, you just became the most useful man in this room.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: Essential worker card. Double rations, travel pass. You work my motor pool three days a week.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: One more thing. Anyone on your block holding fuel or food over thirty days? It's not a crime. It's a count.

choices.text: Gil Shumway. Six jugs of diesel.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: Thank you. That's how this works. Card's yours, effective today.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: Then you're on the standard queue for the card. Two weeks. Unless the motor pool needs you sooner.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You lean over her clipboard. STORES: 140 DAYS. The tally under it says otherwise. 41.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: If this hall hears forty-one, I have a riot by noon and nobody gets anything. Help me buy time.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: Card's yours. Not as a bribe. Because you know, and I need people who know.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The hall goes silent. Then it isn't silent at all.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Two tables down, wearing a lanyard: Carly. She's typing names into a laptop. She sees you and winces.
